2120292157135446160.en_summary: $CRWV says pricing for its older $NVDA Ampere and Hopper GPUs rose 30% to 50% last quarter and now exceeds their original contract rates with new deals extending beyond chips depreciable lives. That makes the ~300K GPUs coming off contract through 2028 particularly interesting as renewing them at today’s prices could generate ~$10B in ARR without any new GPU capex.
2120292157135446160.zh_summary: $CRWV表示其較舊的$NVDA Ampere和Hopper GPU定價上季上漲30%至50%，現已超過原始合約費率，新交易延長至晶片折舊壽命之外。這使得到2028年合約到期的約30萬顆GPU特別有趣，因為以今天價格續約可能在無任何新GPU資本支出的情況下產生約100億美元ARR。
